The presence of an OSI-approved LICENSE file can be objectively verified by checking the repository's LICENSE file and cross-referencing the license identifier against the publicly available OSI-approved licenses list at opensource.org. This is a binary, checkable condition with no subjective judgment required.

The presence of a test file can be objectively verified by inspecting the file names and directory structure within a public repository (e.g., looking for files ending in .test.js, .spec.py, or located in a /tests/ folder).
